answer: Require a cross-branch quorum. The ledger maps identities into invite subtrees, and an answer passes only if its approving graders come from at least three subtrees sharing no inviter within five hops. A hundred clones might rubber-stamp their operator's report on basalt columns along a sea cliff, but they all hang from one branch, so together they fill one slot. Like an atlas checked by surveyors who never met, the work needs strangers' approval; a farm's own branch is no haven for weak work.
